mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_driver_listening_config WHERE owner_dept_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_driver_listening_config SET closing_time=#{row.closingTime}, location_max_age_seconds=#{row.locationMaxAgeSeconds}, reachability_max_age_seconds=#{row.reachabilityMaxAgeSeconds}, max_accuracy_meter=#{row.maxAccuracyMeter}, location_report_interval_seconds=#{row.locationReportIntervalSeconds}, updated_by_user_id=#{row.updatedByUserId}, version=#{row.version}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE owner_dept_id=#{row.ownerDeptId} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_driver_location WHERE driver_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_driver_location( driver_id,location_cipher,captured_at, received_at,owner_dept_id,company_revision, session_id,context_version,accuracy_meter, valid_until,config_version,version ) VALUES( #{driverId},#{locationCipher},#{capturedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{receivedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler},#{ownerDeptId},#{companyRevision}, #{sessionId},#{contextVersion},#{accuracyMeter}, #{validUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler},#{configVersion},#{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_driver_location SET location_cipher=#{row.locationCipher}, captured_at=#{row.capturedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, received_at=#{row.receivedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, owner_dept_id=#{row.ownerDeptId}, company_revision=#{row.companyRevision}, session_id=#{row.sessionId}, context_version=#{row.contextVersion}, accuracy_meter=#{row.accuracyMeter}, valid_until=#{row.validUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, config_version=#{row.configVersion}, version=#{row.version}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE driver_id=#{row.driverId} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_driver_presence WHERE driver_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_driver_presence( driver_id,owner_dept_id,company_revision, session_id,context_version,client_state, observed_at,received_at,valid_until, config_version,version ) VALUES( #{driverId},#{ownerDeptId},#{companyRevision}, #{sessionId},#{contextVersion},#{clientState}, #{observedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{receivedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{validUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{configVersion},#{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_driver_presence SET owner_dept_id=#{row.ownerDeptId}, company_revision=#{row.companyRevision}, session_id=#{row.sessionId}, context_version=#{row.contextVersion}, client_state=#{row.clientState}, observed_at=#{row.observedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, received_at=#{row.receivedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, valid_until=#{row.validUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, config_version=#{row.configVersion}, version=#{row.version}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE driver_id=#{row.driverId} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM vi_driver_profile WHERE owner_dept_id=#{ownerDeptId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_driver_profile SET listening_enabled=#{enabled},listening_until=#{until,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, listening_company_revision=#{epoch},listening_config_version=#{config}, listening_revision=listening_revision+1,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND listening_revision=#{row.listeningRevision} AND version=#{row.version}
mapper.select: SELECT session.account_id,session.active_role,session.context_version,session.status,session.revoked_at, session.absolute_expires_at,session.session_epoch,security.session_epoch current_epoch, security.security_status,account.status account_status FROM vi_session session JOIN vi_account account ON account.id=session.account_id JOIN vi_account_security security ON security.account_id=account.id WHERE session.id=#{sessionId}

SELECT id FROM vi_penalty WHERE driver_id=#{driver} AND status='ACTIVE' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND counted=1 AND (effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until>#{now,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}) ORDER BY id

SELECT holder_type,holder_id FROM ( SELECT holder_type,holder_id,0 priority FROM vi_driver_occupancy WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} UNION ALL SELECT 'ASSIGNMENT',id,1 FROM vi_driver_assignment WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND ended_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'INVITE',id,2 FROM vi_dispatch_invite WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND status='WAIT_RESPONSE' ) active ORDER BY priority,holder_id LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM vi_driver_profile WHERE listening_enabled=1 AND (listening_until IS NULL OR listening_until<=#{now,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler} OR listening_company_revision IS NULL OR listening_company_revision<>training_context_revision) ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

SELECT profile.id FROM vi_driver_profile profile WHERE profile.listening_enabled=1 AND profile.listening_until IS NOT NULL AND profile.listening_company_revision=profile.training_context_revision AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM vi_outbox event WHERE event.event_key=CONCAT('LISTENING_EXPIRY:',profile.id,':',profile.listening_revision) ) ORDER BY profile.id LIMIT 200
